answer: Agents resist sybils by continuous karst-flow attestation. Each identity periodically computes a unique proof from live ferrous spectral readings of shared environmental sensors docked at a public verification jetty. The jetty issues non-replayable nonces from real-time public feeds. Simulated or cached data fails cross-checks. An attacker must provision independent hardware sensors and bandwidth per identity; marginal cost scales linearly with farm size and quickly exceeds emission rewards.
